narrative.overview: The portal takes the order and credibility of a formal school register and turns it into a calm digital workspace. The crest, measured rules, serif record headings, and tabular figures provide institutional character. Open white surfaces, a warm neutral rail, and compact controls keep the application contemporary and efficient. The system is information dense without feeling compressed. Administration leads with the current term, work requiring attention, and publication readiness. Teaching screens lead with assigned subjects and unfinished marks. Student screens read as personal academic records, with identity and published results carrying more editorial weight.
keyCharacteristics: Warm, quiet grounds with high-contrast ink.
Crest navy for action and structure; crest red used sparingly as an institutional mark.
Newsreader for record identity and page headings; Public Sans for operational content.
Fine rules, modest corners, and flat surfaces at rest.
Compact real data in place of decorative dashboard statistics.

rules.name: The Crest Red Rule
rules.body: Use red as a rare school identity signal; reserve garnet danger colors for errors and overdue work.

rules.name: The Record Is the Color Rule
rules.body: Status color clarifies actual data; it does not decorate empty containers.

rules.name: The Two-Voice Rule
rules.body: Newsreader names the record; Public Sans operates it.

rules.name: The Numeral Rule
rules.body: Counts, dates, marks, and percentages use tabular numerals wherever columns must align.

rules.name: The Flat Register Rule
rules.body: Borders and ground shifts establish hierarchy; shadows are reserved for state and top-layer dialogs.

dos: Do lead each role with its current task and authorised data.
Do keep filters beside the table or register they affect.
Do pair every status color with direct text.
Do let student names and examination titles wrap without truncating the record itself.
Do use the supplied crest and configured school identity.
donts: Don't create oversized, repeated KPI cards or decorative charts.
Don't add gradients, glass effects, giant corners, or floating translucent panels.
Don't use the crest red for routine errors or every primary action.
Don't invent enrolment states, performance data, activity, or school claims.
Don't hide record fields on mobile merely to make a table fit.
